# Source-slot parity snapshots

These `.txt` workflow/config payloads preserve the reviewed seven-consumer CI/release source
census. `index.json` records exact hashes, original paths, stage, custody, license,
preset closure and independently reviewed physical token positions. Tests replace
only those fixed positions; they never derive expected output from the parser.
Prepared drafts are historical evidence, not deployed adoption. Kubernetes’s local
reusable-workflow input remains deliberately unowned. Refresh only after source
and provenance review. Existing Renovate `**/tests/**` exclusion covers these
intentional historical pins. No snapshot workflow or generated command is run. The separately hashed legacy
pure-parser fixture is compiled only for the609 compatibility regression.

The held609 parser refuses automatic retry for an initial source upgrade that
changes the new action inputs. A genuine completed exact-candidate/base/authority
receipt can still admit the waiter; if its bounded poll expires, the maintainer
may rerun ordinary CI at the unchanged head after receipt completion. This is
not a new automatic handoff. After610 adoption, the four recorded CI callers
exercise the normal once-only retry with a completed receipt. Publication still
requires actual609 admission and the recorded Pod159/Quad175 service acceptance.
